verdict.rationale: Data export applies to a SaaS agent-evaluation platform like Chronicle, but the pack documents no bulk export, open-format download, or account-exit path. The only related items are ingesting telemetry via an OpenTelemetry exporter and querying events through the SDK or search API. Neither shows that all worlds, tasks, scorers, runs, and traces can be exported in open formats, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404.
